sections.title: Temporary Futures Restrictions & Position Limits
sections.note: Temporary measures. After the war ends, they will return to normal (بعد انتهاء الحرب سترجع للوضع طبيعي).

items.label: Restricted Products
items.detail: Energy: Crude Oil (CL), Natural Gas (NG), E-Mini Natural Gas (QG). Metals: Gold (GC), Silver (SI), Copper (HG), Platinum (PL).

table.title: Micro Commodity Position Limits
table.detail: Applies to: MCL, MGC, SIL, MHG, MNG.

items.label: Max Drawdown
items.detail: Trails upward based on End-of-Day closed P&L, never intraday peaks. Never moves downward. Locks permanently upon reaching the starting balance.

items.label: Inactivity Limit
items.detail: No trading activity breaches the account. Holding overnight or unexecuted pending orders do not count. Countdown starts immediately upon purchase.

items.label: Consistent Trading Size
items.detail: Lot sizes must remain consistent. Large deviations from usual behavior violate standard market risk management.

items.label: Minimum Trading Days
items.detail: Required to pass. Holding an overnight position does not count as a new trading day.

items.label: Challenge Duration
items.detail: Starts immediately upon purchase, includes weekends/holidays, cannot be paused.

items.label: Multiple Accounts
items.detail: Unlimited purchases. Copy-trading allowed on up to 5 accounts. Max 5 active Earning accounts; excess upgrades are queued.

items.label: IP Address
items.detail: Multiple IP changes within the same day raise suspicion of forbidden account sharing.

items.label: Overnight & Weekend Holding
items.detail: Positions open at 14:55 CT (5 mins before close) are force-closed by Risk Managers.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: Permitted but carries high volatility and gap risks.

items.label: Micro-Scalping
items.detail: Entries/exits within 10-15 seconds. Flagged if ~40%+ of profitable trades are ultra-short. Penalties: Warning (Challenge), Profit deduction (Earning). Persistent violation leads to termination.

items.label: Prohibited Strategies
items.detail: Gap Trading: No trades within 2 hours of market close to exploit reopening gaps. HFT/Latency arbitrage results in immediate termination.

items.label: Standard Scalping
items.detail: Permitted across all Challenges and Earning accounts.

items.label: Stop Loss / Take Profit
items.detail: Strongly recommended. Risk Team may enforce SL usage if the majority of trades lack them.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Whichever is lower. A 1% transaction/gas fee is deducted from the final profit share.

items.label: Winning Days Required
items.detail: A Winning Day = ≥ $200 net profit. Non-consecutive. Counter resets after each payout.

items.label: Payout Eligibility
items.detail: Account must be profitable (even by $0.01) since the last baseline to request the next payout.
